requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 使用 A0 光敏电阻 和 D9 PWM LED：光线越强 LED 越暗，当光线极强时（>800）蜂鸣器（D6）短鸣提示
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: io_0=0 then io_0=500 then io_0=800 then io_0=801
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_1 decreases as io_0 increases; at io_0==800 buzzer silent (io_3=0) and io_2 is false; at io_0>800 buzzer on with io_3>0 and status LED io_2 true
